quest.title: The Lost Relic
quest.description: Bao'er claims to have lost a precious relic and is now frantically searching high and low for it. Perhaps she could use a hand...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I was investigating a ruin, when suddenly monsters attacked me...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I panicked and ran, and must have dropped the relic I'd just uncovered right where I found it.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: After the monsters left, I came back, but I couldn't find the relic.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I've searched all over the place and I just can't find it. I wonder if maybe the monsters took it?

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Can you help me search for it? If you find it, you can store it in this box.

talks.objective: Search for the item Bao'er lost

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Hey! Take a closer look, I think you'll find I've padded it with plenty of clothes.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: I'm a professional scholar, don't you know! I don't make rookie errors.

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Anyway, thanks for helping me look for the relic — I'd be useless in a fight with those monsters...

talks.objective: Search for the item Bao'er lost

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... We've looked everywhere — and still, nothing.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Do you wanna keep looking? Or go back and check with Bao'er?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then. This time with your eyes open.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, let's see what else Bao'er has to say.

talks.objective: Retrieve Bao'er's lost item from the monsters

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Let me see... Wow! That's a relic, alright...

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: Um... It doesn't look like the one I lost, though. Still, looks valuable to me!

dialogues.speaker: Bao'er
dialogues.text: This relic needs looking after by an expert. Don't worry, it's safe with me... Hehehe... Thank you both.
